query:
ALTER TABLE tickets 
  CHANGE COLUMN draw_id drawId INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN user_id userId INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN ticket_number ticketNumber VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN total_paid totalPaid INT NOT NULL,
  CHANGE COLUMN payment_status paymentStatus ENUM('pending', 'confirmed', 'failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  CHANGE COLUMN payment_method paymentMethod VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pix',
  CHANGE COLUMN pix_qr_code pixQrCode TEXT,
  CHANGE COLUMN pix_copy_paste pixCopyPaste TEXT,
  CHANGE COLUMN stripe_payment_intent_id stripePaymentIntentId VARCHAR(255),
  CHANGE COLUMN stripe_checkout_session_id stripeCheckoutSessionId VARCHAR(255),
  CHANGE COLUMN created_at createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHANGE COLUMN updated_at updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
